dealer_objection: Price bahut high hai, dusre brand saste hain
voss_label: Lag raha hai initial purchase price dekh kar thoda concern lag raha hai
voss_calibrated_question: Aap decision landing rate par lete ho ya har bag bechne ke baad bachne wale net profit par?
tactical_empathy_phrase: Samajh sakta hoon sir, margin se pehle purchase price par dhyan jana normal hai
physical_rep_coaching_cue: Calm down tone. Do not defend price. Shift focus to ₹400 net dealer profit vs ₹45 legacy profit.
margin_protection_rule: STRICT ZERO DISCOUNT: Never drop ₹690 dealer price. Emphasize ₹400 clean margin.

dealer_objection: Udhaar (credit) do tabhi dukan me mal rakhenge
detected_emotion: Working capital anxiety & cash flow fear
voss_label: Aisa lagta hai ki local market me credit manage karna aapke liye kaafi bada headache ban chuka hai
voss_calibrated_question: 30 din ka credit lekar sirf ₹40 kamana better hai ya 7 din cash discount lekar ₹400 ka solid cash flow banana?
tactical_empathy_phrase: Puri tarah samajhta hoon sir, market me hazaron rupaye udhari me phase hone se tension hoti hai
physical_rep_coaching_cue: Validate credit pain. Reframe Swatch as a cash-flow generator, not another credit burden.
margin_protection_rule: POLICY PROTECTION: Zero uncollateralized credit. Offer 2% Cash Discount for 5-day payment.

dealer_objection: Naya brand hai market me koi maangta nahi hai
detected_emotion: Fear of dead inventory & reputation risk
voss_label: Lag raha hai naye brand me working capital aur counter space block hone ka dar hai
voss_mirror: Naya brand hone me risk lagta hai?
voss_calibrated_question: Agar 7 din me slow stock 100% exchange ho jaye aur bag me ₹50 painter cash token ho toh aur kya risk bachta hai?
tactical_empathy_phrase: Samajh sakta hoon sir, 20 saal ki dukan ki reputation kisi untested brand par lagana easy nahi hai
physical_rep_coaching_cue: Perform Accusation Audit first. Remove risk with 7-day exchange guarantee and real demo boards.
margin_protection_rule: STOCK PROTECTION: Offer 7-day exchange into fast-moving SKUs instead of reducing prices.

dealer_objection: Abhi busy hoon, soch kar agle mahine batayenge
voss_label: Lagta hai aapko decision lene ke liye abhi poori information nahi mili hai
voss_calibrated_question: Aapko comfortable feel karne ke liye mujhse aur kya detail chahiye jisse doubt clear ho sake?
tactical_empathy_phrase: Bilkul samajhta hoon sir, jaldbazi me decision lene ka koi matlab nahi hai
physical_rep_coaching_cue: Isolate the real hesitation. Suggest coming next morning with a 1ft x 1ft real quartz demo board for 2 thekedars.
margin_protection_rule: TIME INTEGRITY: Do not beg or plead. Set a specific 15-minute scheduled appointment.

dealer_objection: Hum sirf Asian Paints bechte hain aur wahi chalta hai
voss_label: Aisa lag lagta hai ki Asian Paints ke alawa kisi brand par experiment karne ki zarurat feel nahi hoti
voss_calibrated_question: Aisa kya karein ki Asian ko replace kiye bina aapki dukan par ek extra high-profit channel add ho jaye?
tactical_empathy_phrase: Sahi baat hai sir, Asian brand pull deta hai aur dukan par footfall banaye rakhta hai
physical_rep_coaching_cue: Agree with Asian's pull. Position Swatch as a secondary high-margin profit pillar (40% vs 4%).
margin_protection_rule: COUNTER INTEGRITY: Never criticize Asian. Contrast 3% margin vs 40% margin.

dealer_objection: Painter naya texture nahi mangega unko purana aadat hai
voss_label: Lagta hai painter aur thekedar ka trust khone ka thoda concern hai
voss_calibrated_question: Agar har bag ke andar ₹50 ka direct cash token mile toh painter trial lene me kitna interested hoga?
tactical_empathy_phrase: Painter ka trust hi counter ki sabse badi asset hoti hai sir, ye hum achhi tarah samajhte hain
physical_rep_coaching_cue: Explain the Painter Partner Program (Milestone rewards up to ₹35,000). Let painter pull the stock.
margin_protection_rule: INCENTIVE INTEGRITY: Highlight ₹50 liquid coupon inside bag; do not give rep cash.

dealer_objection: Margin thoda aur badhao, 10 rupaye aur kam karo
voss_label: Lag raha hai counter par extra profit maximize karne ka pura focus hai
voss_calibrated_question: Agar main rate kam kar doon toh bag me se ₹50 painter cash token hatana padega — kya aap chahenge ki painter aana band kar de?
tactical_empathy_phrase: Samajh sakta hoon sir, har dealer ka haq hai best margin negotiate karna
physical_rep_coaching_cue: Show that cutting company price cuts painter pull tokens or company support. Stand firm with late-night FM DJ voice.
margin_protection_rule: HARD HURDLE LOCK: Company hurdle rate >= ₹100/bag cannot be breached under any circumstance.
